title: Role Configuration
description: Security and responsibility boundaries defining what actors may do. Roles are scoped to Project × Environment.

code.description: Short lowercase code for the role (3 characters)

type.description: Type of actor that uses this role

desc.description: Description of the role's purpose and permissions

alias.description: Alternative name or abbreviation for the role

disabled.description: Whether this role is disabled and unavailable for use

required.description: Whether this role must be created for every project

personal.description: Personal schemas: in these environments every user holding this role gets a copy of each project layer (<PREFIX>_<LAYER>), created by Terraform and owned by SYSADMIN, with the privileges of one access tier for the role

environments.description: Environment codes with personal schemas, usually [dev]

access.description: Access tier the role gets on the personal schemas, granted directly (no access role per person)

accessKey.description: Access tier key (file name under config/accesses): view, read, edit or full

privileges.description: Privileges for this role across different platform concepts

layers.description: Access tier per layer (key = layer key), resolved per environment; the role inherits the layer's access role

roles.description: Role inheritance - parent roles to inherit from

computePrivilegesByEnvironment.description: Compute privileges by environment. Use 'all' for all environments or specific environment codes (dev, tst, acc, prd)

layerAccessByEnvironment.description: Access tier by environment. Use 'all' for all environments or specific environment codes (dev, tst, acc, prd); the environment code wins over 'all'.

roleEnvironments.description: List of environments where this role inheritance applies. Use 'all' for all environments or specific environment codes.

databasePrivilegesByEnvironment.description: Database privileges by environment on top of the implicit USAGE. Use 'all' for all environments or specific environment codes.
